sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 482.6 x 241.3 x 44.45 mm (w x d x h) (axis order assumed); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Dangerous Music Monitor ST / SR manual, opened 2026-11-12 (read as text): a 1U rack unit with 4 stereo main inputs and 3 speaker pairs plus sub on D connectors (Tascam pinout, DB-25 assumed), aux inputs 1 and 2, slate output, cue amp output, talkback remote, a REMOTE jack to the desktop remote (shielded Cat5e, not Ethernet) and a DC IN for an external supply. The manual names no XLR, DIN or RJ45 types: those come from a 2001 Sound On Sound review hosted by the manufacturer. The rack unit size is NOT published: the 312 x 106 mm figures on the product page belong to the desktop remote. The plan size (1U x 19 in x 9.5 in) is a PerfectCircuit dealer listing converted from inches, so the row is an estimate and the device is beta-modelled. No mains inlet (external supply into DC IN, no signal type) and no power switch is stated. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
